Asparagopsis taxiformis — global herbarium morphology explorer

Frond traits measured from 801 herbarium specimens (1854–2024), with long-term environmental conditions at each collection site. Group by MEOW ecoregion, province or realm, or by climate zone; regions are colored red (tropical) or blue (temperate), shaded by median latitude. Click any specimen to see its image and measurements; click a box, ridge, region or centroid to see a collage of its specimens and compare it with another group.
